| | "They are determining the timelines and the levels of the escalation." One line explains more about this war than any single strike does. | | | |
---
THE AXIS FILE — Investigative
---
Who Controls the Escalation Ladder? Saturday's Answer Was Uncomfortable.
---
For two and a half months, Saudi Arabia and its allies have largely set the terms of this conflict's public narrative: strikes, counter-strikes, territorial gains. Saturday's missile fired at Riyadh — the first attempt on the capital itself — suggests a different, less comfortable reality: the Houthis, not the coalition, may be the ones deciding how far and how fast this escalates.
---
Executive Assessment
---
Regional security analyst Yasmeen al-Eryani's observation that the Houthis are "determining the timelines and the levels of the escalation" cuts against the dominant framing of this conflict as a Saudi-led coalition gradually reasserting control. Saturday's attack on Riyadh — a symbolic and strategic capital, not an oil facility or border town — was a deliberate choice of target, made at a moment of the Houthis' choosing, following a week that included a UN Security Council condemnation, a formal defense-pact conversation involving Pakistan, and reports of Saudi Arabia publicly appealing for outside military help. If an actor facing that much diplomatic and interceptor-supply pressure can still escalate on its own schedule, the coalition's control over this conflict's trajectory is weaker than most public narratives assume.
---
The Public Story
---
Much of this month's coverage, including in this publication, has tracked the conflict through a lens of coalition counter-offensives, diplomatic pressure building against the Houthis, and periodic coalition claims of territorial or tactical gains — a framing that implicitly treats Saudi Arabia and its partners as the side setting the conflict's pace.
---
Confirmed Fact: A ballistic missile was fired at Riyadh in the early hours of September 19, intercepted by coalition air defenses. Cruise missiles and drones simultaneously struck Bisha, Taif, Farasan, and an Aramco facility at Yanbu. This is the first documented attempt to strike Riyadh directly since the current escalation began in July.
---
Official Claim: Saudi military spokesman Major-General Turki al-Maliki characterized all attempts to hit civilian infrastructure as "thwarted," framing the event as a defensive success rather than a strategic setback.
---
Our Interpretation: A successful interception is a tactical win but does not change the strategic fact that the Houthis chose to test the capital's defenses at all, on a timeline set entirely by their own operational planning rather than in reaction to any specific coalition provocation that week.
---
The Risk Axis
---
This is a Geopolitical axis risk with a distinct sub-dimension: escalation-control risk, meaning the question of which party can credibly claim to set the conflict's pace, tempo, and target selection. That question now looks considerably more open than it did even a week ago.
---
The Transmission Chain
---
A demonstrated Houthi ability to reach the capital, even if intercepted → reduced Saudi and allied confidence that any target set is genuinely off-limits → increased pressure on Saudi Arabia to secure additional air-defense commitments from allies who have so far been reluctant to formally commit → a longer, more uncertain timeline before any negotiated de-escalation becomes plausible, since neither side currently has clear incentive to be the one seeking terms.
---
Follow the Capital
---
Defense-sector contracts and interceptor-system procurement, both for Saudi Arabia directly and for any allied nation that ultimately does commit hardware, are the clearest capital flow to track; oil markets' pricing of an "open-ended" risk scenario, as reflected in this week's bank commentary, is the clearest indirect signal.
---
Strategic Beneficiaries
---
The Houthi movement gains significant leverage and negotiating position from demonstrating that even the Saudi capital is within reach, regardless of interception success; and any external actor, including Iran, that benefits from a prolonged conflict that ties down Saudi military and diplomatic resources.
---
Cost Bearers
---
Saudi Arabia bears the direct cost in interceptor expenditure, reputational exposure, and the diplomatic awkwardness of publicly seeking help that allies have so far been reluctant to confirm; American and global energy consumers bear the indirect cost through sustained elevated oil prices.
---
American Investor Consequence
---
The practical implication for American investors is that this conflict should be modeled as having no clear ceiling on either duration or geographic scope until proven otherwise — a materially different risk assumption than treating it as a contained, gradually de-escalating regional dispute.
---
Counter-Signal
---
A successful interception, with no casualties or major damage reported, is itself evidence that Saudi Arabia's core air-defense capability around its most critical sites remains functional even under sustained pressure — the capital was tested and, this time, held.
---
What Remains Unknown
---
Whether Saturday's strike was a one-off demonstration or the start of a sustained campaign against the capital specifically, the true state of Saudi Arabia's interceptor inventory, and whether any allied nation will confirm and act on the reported requests for air-defense support.
---
Next Verifiable Checkpoint
---
Any repeat attempt to strike Riyadh or another major population center in the coming days, and any confirmed foreign air-defense deployment to Saudi Arabia.
---

It’s Chris.

You might know that my family immigrated from Greece and opened a business
in Manchester over 100 years ago that we still run today. Our restaurant
lies at the heart of our community.

There’s no VIP section there and no special table you can get for writing
the biggest check that week. Just a small business that taught me and my
family the power of hard work and serving others.

That’s a lot like how we’re running this campaign — powered by people who
chip in a few dollars because they believe in what we’re doing together.
And that couldn’t be more different than my opponent.

Washington.

Friend, Trump has repeatedly floated the idea of sending ICE and the FBI to polling locations this November. State and local election officials are scrambling to prepare for the unthinkable, gaming out what happens if federal agents actually show up at polling places or interfere with voting operations. | [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/139825945/648637062/1071238059?refcode=em-9.23.26-all-3-rs&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTkxNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MmYwZjk2OS1hY2I3LWYxMTEtYTZhOS0wMDIyNDgyYTkzM2IiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xTG-VBZ2Yv4UqgTKOiXq1Ji67BMBx73kTrp5FIlDIHM=) **States prep for ICE agents to be at polls, just in case**
---
**This is exactly why Democratic Secretaries of State matter so much right now: they're on the front lines of this fight.**

# ALL IN FOR ADELITA💙🌵
Adelita for Congress Newsletter
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | Hi Peter,
In just **14 days** , ballots arrive and Arizona’s future is on the line.
Exactly one year ago today, we fought to seat Adelita. We need that same relentless energy to keep her in Congress. This isn’t just another election cycle, it’s a defining midterm moment where every single voice dictates our direction.

As an educator, this weekend’s theme, **Educators for Adelita** , hits close to home. For over 20 years, I’ve had Adelita in my corner, and I’ve watched her fight relentlessly for our schools, our teachers, and our students. She has always shown up for us, now it’s our turn to send her back to Congress!
That is why I am asking you to join our[**Educators for Adelita Canvass**](https://us.list-manage.com/vxcy0u_hNbW?e=f7c3700ccb&c2id=444a9f520cb2092400304c5b9d69cefc)**** this Saturday, September 26th at 8:30AM from our **Tucson HQ at 2720 East Broadway BLVD**.**OR**
Let’s go to Bisbee this Saturday, September 26th at 9:30AM for our [**Bisbee: All in for Adelita canvass**](https://us.list-manage.com/xrilQTwsQKV?e=f7c3700ccb&c2id=444a9f520cb2092400304c5b9d69cefc) , leaving from our Tucson HQ **2720 East Broadway BLVD** at **7:00AM SHARP!**
Let’s fight for our people, our pueblo, especially our future, it is on the line!

body:
Peter, it has been 49 days since we won that primary together; only a few weeks since we launched this general election. November already feels so close.
I want to level with you about what those weeks have looked like from where I sit. This email is a little long, but I hope you'll stay with me. 🙏
**The Republicans were waiting for us.** By the time we finished a tough primary, Mike Rogers' side had already spent more than $45 million on air to make him look good. He is a 30-year career politician and Donald Trump's handpicked candidate, with over a year of spending and statewide name recognition _already_ built.
And they didn't stop at the flattering Rogers ads. They had attack ads on us ready to go. Sometimes brutal. Sometimes offensive. Sometimes just silly.
The right-wing media and influencer world has been running waves of it. Attacks on my religion. Calling our most basic proposals (what if everyone had health care?) “communism.” Clipping every little thing I've ever said out of context.
I have the wrong name, I pray the wrong way, I have the wrong skin color. They have decided that's the whole argument this election will hinge on.
**Peter, they need to distract Michiganders to win. If this election is a side-by-side matchup of our ideas against theirs, it's a rout in our favor.**
We stand for money out of politics, money in your pocket, and Medicare for All. They stand for jacking up your drug costs, spending your tax money abroad on useless wars, and taking as much corporate cash as humanly possible along the way.
And Rogers has a paper trail on every bit of it:
* He’s the same guy who championed the trade deals that outsourced hundreds of thousands of Michigan manufacturing jobs.

* The same guy who raked in over a million dollars from Big Pharma and Wall Street banks, including over $400,000 in campaign contributions from big drug companies.

* The same guy who called himself the “champion” of the opioid industry while tens of thousands of Michiganders were dying of overdoses, and he backed legislation giving drug makers near “absolute immunity” from deaths and damages their drugs cause.

* Then he left Congress, increased his net worth by up to $14 million working for the corporations he used to regulate, and moved to Florida.

That's the record they'd rather this race _not_ be about, which is why they want it to be about my name instead.
I'm a doctor, not a politician. As a public servant, I spearheaded a program that will cancel up to $700 million in medical debt for 300,000 Michiganders and got free glasses onto the faces of thousands of kids who needed them.
**If voters see all of that laid bare, we win big. If the MAGA media machine derails this election because we don't have the resources to answer, we could lose.** That's just me being blunt about the stakes here.
It's also what I'm thinking about heading into the end of the month...
September 30 marks another quarterly FEC deadline, the first of this general election, and the last before Election Day. **_The only way this goes right is if we hit our $5 million end-of-quarter goal, because that's what fuels the operation getting our message out: TV, mail, events, and the doors._**
We won the most expensive Democratic Senate primary in the country's history without a single dollar from corporate PACs while more than $70 million was spent against us.
That fight nearly beat us, and it emptied our bank account at the exact moment the real one started. Now, the biggest MAGA spenders have committed $70 million to elect Rogers, and their attack ads are already on the air.

That deadline is one week away. I am looking for 50 patriots to step up in the next 30 minutes to help us post a report that shows the strength of this campaign heading into November. Annie Andrews has been campaigning - and raising millions from liberals all over the country for over a year - way before I even thought about getting in this race. My liberal opponent didn’t have to run two statewide, competitive campaigns this summer. I did. What I do have is almost thirty years of working for the people of South Carolina, the values Lindsey and I were both raised on, and the support of great people like you. It helps us compete with the millions in my opponent's campaign account and shows the country we're serious about winning in November. Our campaign wouldn't be here without the grassroots support of people like you. Right now, I need you with me more than ever. Thank you, Darline Graham P.S. Annie Andrews, Chuck Schumer, and every liberal in the country will be watching our third-quarter numbers. There’s been another huge development in my U.S. Senate race, Peter. Let me explain.
President Trump and JD Vance both came to North Carolina to personally attack me at rallies with my MAGA opponent, Michael Whatley – and while Trump was here, he called our state "one of the worst in the whole nation" and even repeated the lie that our cities are "blood-soaked killing fields." Stephen Miller has gone on Fox News to rant and rave about me. Far-right super PACs are flooding the airwaves with more than $100 million in baseless ads lying about who I am and what I’m fighting for.
They’re coming after me with everything they’ve got because they know if they can just beat me in November, it won’t matter what happens in other swing states. If the GOP wins in North Carolina, it’s game over. They’ll likely keep control of the Senate until 2029.
Unfortunately, Peter, their attacks are working. **Another new poll just came out showing this race is statistically tied.**
**That’s why I need your help, Peter. We’re getting outspent, and without your immediate grassroots support, we could put our shot at flipping this seat at risk.[_So if you care about winning in North Carolina and retaking the Senate, making a donation of $5 to my campaign today is the best thing you can do to help me fight back, protect our narrowing lead and win. name: Gina Hinojosa
subject: A message for Peter
body:
We're 88.4% of the way to our $3M goal before the 9/24 TEC deadline. Here's why I'm writing to you specifically:
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter, this isn't one of our usual campaign updates. I know you hear from my team often, so I wanted to write to you myself today because we've hit a moment in this race that I don't think anyone saw coming a year ago.
**In the last week, two separate independent polls have shown me leading Greg Abbott for the very first time. Siena has me at 49% and Abbott at 45%. Marist, who just released their poll last night, has me at 49% and Abbott at 46%.**
[****](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260923_4_message.WvPZ_K&refcode=em20260923-2212&amount=5&t=1&akid=2212%2E299639%2EWI2His)
Abbott had never been shown trailing in a public poll before last week — in any race he’s ever run. In twelve years and three campaigns for governor, Abbott has never faced anything like this.
But here's what worries me: September 24 is our first public fundraising deadline since June 30. For nearly three months, nobody has seen Abbott's numbers, and we have no idea how much money he's stockpiled to dump on us at the end of this race.
Abbott has already announced a $12 million ad buy against me, and there’s no telling what else he has coming down the pike. If his plan to buy back his lead in this race works, if he pulls ahead this month, clawing our way back in October will be brutally hard. _**This is the moment when your support in this race matters most, Peter.**_
**That’s why we set a goal to raise $3 million before the September 24 TEC deadline. This is the minimum amount of money we need to raise, and falling short is not an option. As of today, we’re 88.4% of the way there.**
According to our records, you haven't had the chance to chip in yet this month, and I wanted to make sure you heard about where we stand from me before the deadline passes.
Here's what I want you to understand about timing: This race has been a tossup all summer, and Greg Abbott has been sitting on his money in the dark. He’s only just starting to spend his warchest, so the window where your grassroots donation can help us hold onto our lead is _right now_.
**[Will you make your first contribution of the month right now, even just $5, and help us raise the $3,000,000 we urgently need to by tomorrow night?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260923_4_message.WvPZ_K&refcode=em20260923-2212&amount=5&t=3&akid=2212%2E299639%2EWI2His)**
[Donate $5 »](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260923_4_message.WvPZ_K&amount=5&refcode=em20260923-2212&t=22&akid=2212%2E299639%2EWI2His)
Thank you,
Gina
_Our records aren’t perfect – if you’ve donated with a different email address, phone number, or by check, not all of your gifts may be reflected in our accounting here. Our team greatly appreciates all of your support in electing me as the next Governor of Texas!_

[ Donate » ](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_gh_footer?refcode=em20260923-4&t=23&refcode2=2212_299639_WI2His&akid=2212%2E299639%2EWI2His)

Peter, we knew this was coming – even so, **it's not good.**
JD Vance has visited North Carolina to rally the GOP base and spread lies about me. MAGA loyalist Stephen Miller has gone on Fox News to rant and rave about me. President Trump’s DHS Secretary, Markwayne Mullin, has perpetuated lies against me on Newsmax, and the president himself has personally attacked me on social media in front of his millions of followers.
Now, Trump is upping the ante because this race in North Carolina could decide Senate control: MAGA Inc.’s super PAC is pouring millions into the effort to defeat me, bringing total Republican spending in this race to over $100 million (and counting).
**Peter, those attacks are working: A new poll shows our already narrow polling lead _cut in half._**
We warned folks that this was going to be a close race. In North Carolina, winning a U.S. Senate race by a "landslide" means winning, at best, 51% of the vote. That’s how competitive our state is, no matter what the pundits or the latest ratings say.
Unfortunately, many people seem to have turned their attention elsewhere, and as a result, we’re losing critical ground with just weeks to go until the election.
**I know we can get back on track, but not if we get complacent. In Congress, you’re up for re-election every two years. Truth be told, it feels like we’re running every single year just to keep our seats.
The "big boys" and the heavy hitters aren't exactly lining up to write me checks. They aren't for us, and if I’m being honest, I’m not for them either. I guess that makes us even.
Here’s why I’m coming to you, Peter:
* I don't have the big corporate checkbooks behind me, and I like it that way. It means I’m not beholden to anyone but you.

* The Power of Small Donations: Our campaign is built on folks who work hard for every dollar they earn. That’s our people.

* It’s a tough gig to stay in office when you're taking on The Establishment, but with your help, we can keep at it.

[So, I’m humbly asking you to chip in a few bucks towards my Third Quarter Fundraising Goal right now. Whether you can give $1 or $10 right now – those small donations are what keep this ship moving.](https://trk.email.tim-burchett._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmYW1vdW50PTM1JmV4X3RpZD0yMDI2MDkyNF9MOS1BSC4xMTAxMTdfdDIwMzQ0NDUtNDEyNSZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249MjAyNjA5MjRfTDktQUguMTEwMTE3X3QyMDM0NDQ1LTQxMjUifQ/cXwAu_bJ1xCZ0BGkf8optA)

## US Walks Out as Iran Speaks at UN
Iran's president [defied President Trump](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOnTAQRb_GdPNkxoaFgiIN3aZNiQZ7eEzWz0a2AW2-Pnr5hdT36ujo_PpcPkmCxOdPevFUt7REvkvgWjkvT_pDmddTgpf4PALFbZWd3NeCGnvQI6BdyFW5eLHU-GljRjYNT-3HqNFaY7DZp6FdvXG9J2f1hth1ejVmsJunDtvVDY1Mb54e0bZadzg-BuuYjOl0qzeLQ6esZi815cfvJLHuvIXvdHF-uPRqwrTXehRlfiicFc51511CeG8K5yMFcd8KZ4mVc6QqKVJQOPet7q0ZQTJFODIX8RwrVA6hwBnhZrglBIh8cYY13ZDODDuTBypwFrgpfBVIZ1U4N3nyx_supf9QVj9fJP8MmvqfUa8J_wYAAP__RAuNKg) at the U.N. General Assembly on Wednesday, vowing "we will never bow our head" as the U.S. representative walked out. A day earlier, Trump had used his own speech there to say he was weighing whether to "annihilate" Iran. President Masoud Pezeshkian [held up photos](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL1uhDAQhJ8GOpBZmx8XLtLQXdqUaM9eYHPGRsZ36PL0EXmFtN9Io5nv6zbdkD2H5RM3MnmOU6Dz8JQzpWnBH0x0f7J3HJbdY5jvvKJ9TCCgq4SuQE1oM79oUlg6MxMByZJM02sBSkkJ5Wq0wBml1oMSthHa2k5Z2buu106TaF3J5uoTGlQjRAu6HpQllLIVjZgVDG2hBDnOMdXfkUNeafbv-KJU27iV3qw570chPwoYCxjP86zfuMZ4pQWM16ELx-RdASOmzNbThXJ6bnvlyNOCmaoT_eOoOGE4qj3RwY5Crhqlemh1M9Rr3nyZjNtP9p6Pri-UWDZk_zcj_9Pey8BvAAAA__-z4oSK) he said showed schoolchildren killed in the war and called Iran a "victim of terrorism." After the speech, a White House spokesperson told the media Iran is an "evil country" that must never have a nuclear weapon. U.S. envoys [spent three hours trading messages](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOnDAQhJ_GdCB77TugcJGG7k-bEi14gU2MQfZyKHn66K7IC6QZaTTS6NP342v8Qo6c1u-4k5flGBPdJZII5XHFP5hpujgGTusZMS0Tbzj_GkHDs9Z9DW7EWfhFo8Mq-IUIyFbkTdtrcM5aqDaP7WS7lgwFsqRda5ybuhaeizUEVoeK_ftP9-CM1g_om87NhNY-tNGLg-6hnKbAcuTm58FJNlri7-NFuZmPvYp-EzmLst8UDAqG-76bIplPKu9dwSAboVAuCobrHf_orYKBM6Y6cJmvUvhIpb4SC4U6oXyq5Gs_a9kyoZQaoHfGgG022WOVfThvjpHLs1VOrzty_DDJf6p8efgbAAD__7Tth-M) with Iran through Qatari mediators on Tuesday, the first talks since a ceasefire collapsed this summer. There was no breakthrough, but Trump predicted a deal "right after the elections."
## Trump Board Unveils $2.45B Gaza Plan
President Trump's Board of Peace [unveiled a $2.45 billion](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LHO3CAMwPGnIZtPnCF3l4Hhqorta4cOHSMCTkJLIAKS6OvTV_QVOlv62_79_Bg_jA8-Lt_MRqrOaYx0lUC1Uh4X88dkmg4fnI_LHkycJ78a-3tEjg_gA6Acja3-pFGazqmZCEl0pO7PgaOUQmC3KunkxO-uN9MgeyQaCB-9c_LpcOKDfXVetR4fUN4573G4vaQlI0TP73yW-OqZ5OR8Tfn2K_lYV5rDZzop32zauqDWWvfCxJuhZqiv67ptJbYZQ00RjsJQt7cY6lRXygx1sSntUPOx7VBgSiY7SDPsZCxBTXDEk3wABNnD5EPwKULjgEy2bf6ExsFQmwzvN9rvx6MyoZP1jomvXxooXeUH5b3Lyu1XS5THk0m-bMaHf4fX__Q-Ff4NAAD__yrrldQ) plan Wednesday to rebuild Gaza over the next six months. Its 66 projects are meant to lay the groundwork for a new Palestinian administration. About $1 billion would go to infrastructure, including $400 million for insulated temporary homes to move displaced families out of tents and $275 million to clear rubble and unexploded bombs. [Another $885 million](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkbGu1DAQRb_G6bzyjp1stkixCEWieFAgQRlNnHEy4NiR7bfR4-uRl0-gvtK9Ouf-fJvekD2H9SvuNBQXp0Bn9lQKpWnFP5hofme_cFgPj8HNvKH9PYGCTqq7BDOhLfykyWCzDI4ISDc0XG93BcZoDc02wAJaq67H2-yc7pzq5sWg7a_u1qsWbMND7VN3MFelWrhfemMJtW7VVTkDfSuMooVLTJdfkUPZyPmP-KR0sXFv_LCVcmShHwJGAeN5npc9h5oJGClIDgLGiiVgjGWjJGCsaDKRrS0fsqLJLZ6ypPf9yBJMK2f2nmP4lx0pHjFTliXKlw-JMtApD_SUCwfGIHHZOXAuCQvHOolJPh5gv_1wX4Qeo-VF6M-fqms683dKR5OG5TjrTu5uwqh1R_YvpvKfVzwH-BsAAP__N5qguw) covers security, including a base in Rafah for up to 5,000 international troops and a $20 million buyback program for weapons held by Hamas and other armed groups. The package isn't fully funded yet, and it depends on cooperation from both Israel and Hamas. Officials hope work can begin after Israel's Oct. 27 elections. "_There are no shortcuts. No Plan B,_ " White House envoy Steve Witkoff said.

Last week, Fox News posted the results of a survey that they had conducted. The results could not have been worse for the Republicans.
It was so bad Fox couldn't even spin it. The headline read, "Squeezed by costs, frustrated voters turn to the Democrats." Sixty-three percent of registered voters in the poll said the Trump Administration has made the economy worse.
When asked which political party would do a better job on specific issues, the Democrats led by at least ten points on Inflation and Prices (+15%), Large AI Data Centers (+14%), Corruption (+11%), and Foreign Policy (+10%). Republicans led in only one category, Immigration, and that was only by one point.
Republicans are failing, and the people have noticed.
Here in Alabama, Democrats can thank our local Republican Party for giving us the best Christmas a kid could imagine. It's as if they're trying to prove they aren't a serious party. At the top of the ticket, they have a man who is openly racist and doesn't live in the state. For Lt. Governor, they have a guy who admitted to election fraud and doesn't meet the residency requirements for the office. In an act of desperation and fear, they redrew the congressional district lines after voting had begun. Their congressional candidates are running from the public as fast as they can to avoid questions, and they don't seem able to come up with a coherent theory of governance to run on... well, except maybe "We're really MAGA," but those polls show that's not the flex it once was.

I'm just a senator with a big mouth who happens to stand for common-sense things like... strong borders, safe streets, a powerful economy, bringing jobs to my constituents, and Israel and Ukraine's right to defend themselves, not to mention the basic machinery of our democracy (the Electoral College, the Senate, and the Supreme Court). ## Rangers Probe Manslaughter at Camp Mystic
The Texas Rangers believe Camp Mystic's leaders [committed manslaughter](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGupCAUhp9GOyaIjGJBsc10d9stzREOSBZhAueK8_Yb7yts-edPvnz5_nytXxBiSP43HKjpcnlN2GpEIizrFjzhVbfgdyDCC2oLCX2BVXAxMb4wIVcwFE5cJfRWb9wuQ496mBcu5KwG2e9aPVEoK6bRKQlqmJ7PAUbrFJ8WIUfkfdA3ji9CDgMfR_GY3WSUcrPZ1Pycl6mTHG2gXB6044-Hi598YnmYfPRR70Tv2o2_OvHqxKu19vh7QbrPTrxCOrFS8EAhp9qJV0UoZmcNSoFElRk43uz4VAqG5ZawVGbyd7TMgUF2QKoRvv1OWJjZoXisDNy9LIKNH-ZizvYG90XbdwsxhjrNneT-gBB_FOl_055a_AsAAP__lFmSbA) and four other crimes in the deaths of 25 campers and two counselors in the July 4, 2025, flood, search warrants show. Ranger investigator Brant Johnston wrote that the camp skipped emergency drills and left some cabins short of counselors. Owners [monitored late-night flood warnings](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkbHOozAMgJ8mbK5CoKQMDLew_bfeiExiwLqQVIlL27c_wSvcZsnS9_mT__xMP8iB4_obdxrks6Qp0rsEEqE8zbwKfcrM64Yi9MHy5khrxslo04HuwbQTOuGDphYrP8za93VFQ217bVr7qNtqG7zVvrZkbTN737u-0bOe70vbuRnvuqOKhxOne9PWtW4ac7NL5x6Pxbr5Ye-271SrybOkfJONrjuW8E0H5ZtLexWGTeRZVPNLmVGZMX6fqci5UmY8ycqMuj_nRpnxVeAsVGZ0uD9h_xZhBws6KuAy7xwxAMeDivCKwikCFrikkDGulAsUor9AB3uKjiAtsGMsAV_rJpQhyUb5YlEBjrCElDx4QtlObZUH_3xzCFw6q1q97sjhCpH_fcAxmH8BAAD__x40noY) but never moved girls from low-lying cabins, and the camp "consciously disregarded a substantial and unjustifiable risk of death," he wrote. The 14 warrants seek emails, call logs, GPS data, and photos from the Eastland family, which ran the camp, and seven staff members. A state-led review found Camp Mystic [had no written emergency plan](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGypCAQRb8GM6awZUQCgk3M3qYbWi222FWIFvCceX-_5QT7A5ufPnX6_vmavpAjp_Abd3L1vR5ToleJVCvlaeZQ6V1mDhvWSm8sL04UMk6goJfKStAT-soXTRqbxc1qsW1DrjVWgTZDq5vNPXuLT4Om02C7vqeWgFZvLRr7NODXht2tUxZ026qug4dZez8Mq_HzYJ7G9kIrWrge-VE3-nSs8ee4KD_8sTfRbbWeRXS_BIwCxoIJU6B4RL7oJgSM91MCRp95JwHjv_xOwPgRynzf5CLP71y-OQV5s5wwSk4XlcoBKx9JetxPuf-Uyr7JbjlfHCOX3gitwo4cP0n1f6e8HPwNAAD__4Nois4) required by law. No one has been charged, and Eastland family members and other camp leaders refused investigators' interview requests. The camp, which never reopened and is in bankruptcy reorganization, has [denied liability](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLEOmzAURb_GbEbm4WIYPGRhSztVHdHDPMOTjEltJyR_X5Ff6Hh1paNz75_7dEcOHNefuJMtb39Mkc4cqBRK08xroXeeed2wFHpjPjnSmnACBZ1UgwQ9oSv8okljtdhZLUNTkW3MoECbvtHVZgdyPbSOnNOezKxmb6DpjcLWNUunfMX2wqkBdNOotoXa-M71vTdu7s0PM3RCK1q4HKkuG309fPgcL0q1O_Yq2K2URxbtTcAoYDzPs95zvDoBI0X5zALGa5aA8SgbJQHjlyId7g_p0VGWO8Yc8LluhZLk-PfJ6SPRXwmMXDmFLBcmyVH6cByLgBGTvN3A_frNW5Xs8jg5BM6dEVqtO3L42pX_ffVl4V8AAAD__4yzjvY), calling the flood an unforeseeable natural disaster.
## DPS Error Stalls Voter Registrations
An error at the Texas Department of Public Safety left an unknown number of [voter registration applications](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOtSAQhZ8GOw2MKFhQ_I3d_dstDeKIJFwxMKt3336jr7DdV8yc8-V8vaaXDTHs_r99o6HPmqYdrxKRCPM0B0_4KXPwmyXCjy1X2NFnOwGHvuZDDXKyjsKJk7TVYma-DKJCI9TAQSotZLWZZYVu7lzbyrlTSmjRgdNCo0Q1rBpVFcwdxweQQvC2hUatvdN6VW7WqlNDzyTHJVDKDW34eKzxJ52YG5feVTQb0VFY-4_ByGC8rqs5E-GMlpqUPYPx-WEw3j0MRj7cDAzG-y7XGX0olC2FtNf2OGJwD5f6ez9yclgKLvVylBpzTpnBWGWzHFeIMZReMcn924b42NBfVzwN_AYAAP__asuIKw) sitting unprocessed, and counties began receiving the backlog overnight Tuesday, less than two weeks before the Oct. 5 deadline. The applications came through the DPS online driver's license portal, which roughly 6 million Texans used to register between 2020 and 2024. State officials said the transactions produced incomplete records that [never reached county registrars](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOozAQhJ8GOiPbOBgKF9eky7VXorW9gBWDo_UKcm__K3mFv58ZffP9e8wPSDkd61_Y0fF7KfOBV83IjDT7tDK-q0_rBsz4hnqlA1eCWUs9CDkJbWYInE6cDbTReRkn1aJTdpLa2FGZdnMapz6oOCk0wdsIvUQwMkbQS7DWQ5vcZ05O2igl-153dhnCOC42-NHe7DQ0RmJMXKjjDb8cS_5fTqQulL3NbmN-1ab_0-h7o-_XdXWfExfi8xNo9P3bEWdhJEG4psoEnMohkKiQqC-gZxU1EOw-o_C4FEKxp8hIexVKG2uNvrXk4utKOac62MbIdYeUvwz8W3en0z8BAAD__9geh5Y). Officials haven't said what information was missing, how many voters were affected, or when the problem started. Voters who registered through DPS but don't appear on the rolls can cast a provisional ballot, the secretary of state's office said. Harris County, meanwhile, has about [300,000 voters on its suspense list](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDGS4yAQRU-DMlyojYUIFGxCNptuqMLQkroGgwvakuf2W_IVJuug67_3_7-v-ctTorz-9Q-c-L2UOePREjJjne-0Mr7bndbNM-Pbt4MyrtXPoGCQykrQsw9MO87ad3G6q2j7DqfeWAXajL3utilqFZVdRrtoxJs3GDEaexsNqsHqATuazjhlQfe9ul7hYpYhjONiwn00N2MHoRVG4lIvvOHHY0k_Zcd6CeXRpWljfjZx_SPACXDHcVxCovANW3k1Lvn8EuDOYgJcKsEnAe5kCnDKnjcIcJuvlZoM5ZX5Ryb0EWuTr7qiPJm5SS4ybBi-JS1yL4xVVlypcfVMJUtqsmTZXu2JuaFM1FiA6-oUnwelRG0wQqv14Sl9xPm3g-8T_A8AAP__Q7eYIA), most often because their mail was returned undeliverable. Those voters are still registered and can vote after filling out a statement of residence at the polls.

Big Tex will top out in [a 95-gallon Resistol](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL-StCAQxJ8GMywYWZCA4EvM9ksvtFAHnSpXt2Ru8d7-Sl_h0vnT3b_-evbPSCtt8__4wsBn2vsNS16RGY9-oJnxzAPNS2TGM-ZCG85H7EGBlcpLMH0cmT7Ym1hNYVCT1xUG7bwC41ptqiVg1GC1mhpvDPpGg52sH1tjrHEPNaWKwiWnPBitVdNA7ZId2za5cWjdw3krjMKJeD9qXvDOkdaf_YNHPe6vag0L8zuL5p-ATkBXSqnHIV8c115Ad78I6K6RgG6gWTKeMnNklCnSIfck7yN5g21Y5P7NiVhAVx1hehdaV8rWCaPmV6T1Nua_FvYJ8BsAAP__ZbKAQg) when the State Fair of Texas opens Friday, the first time the 55-foot cowboy has worn a hat from the Garland maker. body:
As the last Democrat representing a battleground district in Pennsylvania, we do need resources.
# [](https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/46?t=1&akid=101%2E42639%2EZ5GF4T)
Good morning, Willis.
We've sent a number of fundraising emails before our final quarterly FEC fundraising deadline of the election, so I thought it important to take a moment to explain why these requests mean so much to our campaign.
Then, yes... I am going to ask you to make a contribution to my campaign. If taking back the House and sending a great rebuke to John Fetterman is important to you, I hope that you will.
Here's why:
First, I try not to send a billion fundraising emails. And another thing I'll never do is fill your inbox with misleading messages about quadruple matches or other hair-on-fire requests you probably see a lot of.
We try to raise what we need to win this election, to help elect a few other Democrats trying to flip seats in Pennsylvania, and anything left over we'll put to work next cycle.
As the last Democrat representing a battleground district in Pennsylvania, we do need resources.
And if you are someone who is frustrated with John Fetterman, your donation today has an added bonus. Because the truth is, the press will likely be looking at our FEC report as an indication of how dissatisfied Democrats are with Senator Fetterman. He'll probably see it too.
I'll wrap this up by saying that there is no greater single source of donations to this campaign than emails like this one. That means from time to time I have to ask. And with our final quarterly FEC deadline of the campaign coming up fast, today is one of those days.

name: Captain Mike Bouchard
subject: I know you probably think this is a scam
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Michael Bouchard, Inc
body:
It's not. And this race is too close to ignore. | | | Peter, Most people who get this email will delete it without reading a single word.
Some will think it's spam. Some will think it's a scam.
I get it. Your inbox is flooded with political emails from people you've never heard of. So let me be straight with you: this is real.
My name is Captain Mike Bouchard. I'm an Army paratrooper and Bronze Star recipient, and I'm running in one of the tightest House races in America.
It's Michigan's 10th District — John James' seat. The last time it was open, it was decided by about 1,600 votes.
Now it's open again. **It's rated a TOSS-UP.** And it could decide who controls the House.

---
So when I ask you to chip in, I'm not asking you to fund one campaign for one election. I'm asking you to invest in the next **two years.**
Two years of a Republican majority backing President Trump's agenda — _instead_ _of_ Democrats trying to impeach him again.
Two years of keeping Hakeem Jeffries away from the Speaker's gavel.
And a stronger, safer America for our kids and grandkids — for generations to come.
That's what's riding on this one seat.
If you've read this far, you're already one of the few. Thank you. Truly. It means the world to me.

clean_body: It's not. And this race is too close to ignore. | | | Peter, Most people who get this email will delete it without reading a single word. Some will think it's spam. Some will think it's a scam. I get it. Your inbox is flooded with political emails from people you've never heard of. So let me be straight with you: this is real. My name is Captain Mike Bouchard. I'm an Army paratrooper and Bronze Star recipient, and I'm running in one of the tightest House races in America. It's Michigan's 10th District — John James' seat. The last time it was open, it was decided by about 1,600 votes. Now it's open again. It's rated a TOSS-UP. And it could decide who controls the House. So when I ask you to chip in, I'm not asking you to fund one campaign for one election. I'm asking you to invest in the next two years. Two years of a Republican majority backing President Trump's agenda — instead of Democrats trying to impeach him again. Two years of keeping Hakeem Jeffries away from the Speaker's gavel. And a stronger, safer America for our kids and grandkids — for generations to come. That's what's riding on this one seat. If you've read this far, you're already one of the few. Thank you. Truly. It means the world to me. **That deadline is less than one week away.**

**[Peter, I am asking for your help because we're behind where we should be.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=afdddbd594504b1e8e75a35c59122baa&_e=JUtKgaLVtFti_9Q7kz91kxXVMgpLwv7EZ4i4su489maL6zLIUnxZcxuOGGHzxZILdeD8TvLobs-MggPdYJNW8e_CvhV4vWmbQ0ZVRSHeml_7Ne2p8MQ3467GVOONJKREHdtFjUSmfCPxv8DVe5eeL1eZkHQqPWwlcmlpIA3VNQwUr1LETEsfFuV-T-bPSPRL3glUKwwvZg8cVTcnfa4JLGep4SQqDuj3ibwdFGzRiMPVou2w0STEAgpjeAUONAqrLesUayUg3vOhF5U3pLlZXKsGkss4rlxHXjea33XD0gLWDE8JJD0UxknggXj2EYw1Lmt-BWJCEfBa9DowTyDv9mUDJsCqF1SZbgp5N-wp2-_7SrJEZyPOdB1QuOt-q1aIxDq1qvUzhv6PfaPrmknJALQ1BEnHs-cHCNW_Ia1T4HqhcnaEYQWAYr8CIv0MpU7aoaq5-EbhhgtOIVZVC_EKHDpVuEi9WN7LOFEPxeo4rsbTHIQH-p9hmi0mFkVO17EL-ZqUuCB9WoIrXC_HQCw96lQeusswy7LjsNV386e4rTMlBvvnxt2pwHMcjpcdGYtBC1W696ya0baGhGqvbYiudFpKk4IBKSYc5lzGYDS72ORfDIbZ_TLZhyRPuGkK0e4PGFZKj9KrG-pr0BphPthjxuMT_YB7o62cHxbeDHqGnhhcwR1BQQrfrxiDDpwNLzoj_-jCQNlKFdBfX37OPelP5xTzUq4MkPTGficvringwYi4lg1b1YcjyZQNNtWdD6Wsl-tHq1GS_D2r98CcItOJ_DdbA8UiFd4h0cZfa1QdEYs%3D)**

I am looking for 50 patriots to step up in the next 30 minutes to help us post a report that shows the strength of this campaign heading into November.

Annie Andrews has been campaigning - and raising millions from liberals all over the country for over a year - way before I even thought about getting in this race.

name: Lieutenant Colonel Alex Vindman, US Army, Retired
subject: The Washington Post
body:
Peter: A little more than six years ago, I retired from active military service.
I had no intention to resign from a career I loved, having served for more than 21 years in uniform. But it became clear that Donald Trump had a vendetta against me, and that he would do everything in his power to punish me for speaking truth to power.
On that first day of retirement, I wrote an article in _The Washington Post_ discussing the need to have public servants with the moral courage to protect our democracy. This is more relevant than ever.
I’ve attached the op-ed below. It's an important reminder of why doing what's right matters. Thank you for taking a few minutes to read it.
Before you go, please make a donation to my brother Eugene's re-election to Congress.
**[DONATE](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/evfc-em-sep26?refcode=em260925-av&refcode2=1135_3892029_ytlr9G&akid=1135%2E3892029%2Eytlr9G)**
* * *

[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/evfc-em-sep26?refcode=em260925-av&refcode2=1135_3892029_ytlr9G&akid=1135%2E3892029%2Eytlr9G)
**Alexander Vindman: Coming forward ended my career. I still believe doing what’s right matters.**
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/evfc-em-sep26?refcode=em260925-av&refcode2=1135_3892029_ytlr9G&akid=1135%2E3892029%2Eytlr9G)
After 21 years, six months and 10 days of active military service, I am now a civilian. I made the difficult decision to retire because a campaign of bullying, intimidation and retaliation by President Trump and his allies forever limited the progression of my military career.
This experience has been painful, but I am not alone in this ignominious fate. The circumstances of my departure might have been more public, yet they are little different from those of dozens of other lifelong public servants who have left this administration with their integrity intact but their careers irreparably harmed.
A year ago, having served the nation in uniform in positions of critical importance, I was on the cusp of a career-topping promotion to colonel. A year ago, unknown to me, my concerns over the president’s conduct and the president’s efforts to undermine the very foundations of our democracy were precipitating tremors that would ultimately shake loose the facade of good governance and publicly expose the corruption of the Trump administration.
At no point in my career or life have I felt our nation’s values under greater threat and in more peril than at this moment. Our national government during the past few years has been more reminiscent of the authoritarian regime my family fled more than 40 years ago than the country I have devoted my life to serving.
Our citizens are being subjected to the same kinds of attacks tyrants launch against their critics and political opponents. Those who choose loyalty to American values and allegiance to the Constitution over devotion to a mendacious president and his enablers are punished. The president recklessly downplayed the threat of the pandemic even as it swept through our country. The economic collapse that followed highlighted the growing income disparities in our society. Millions are grieving the loss of loved ones and many more have lost their livelihoods while the president publicly bemoans his approval ratings.
There is another way.
During my testimony in the House impeachment inquiry, I reassured my father, who experienced Soviet authoritarianism firsthand, saying, “Do not worry, I will be fine for telling the truth.” Despite Trump’s retaliation, I stand by that conviction. Even as I experience the low of ending my military career, I have also experienced the loving support of tens of thousands of Americans. Theirs is a chorus of hope that drowns out the spurious attacks of a disreputable man and his sycophants.
Since the struggle for our nation’s independence, America has been a union of purpose: a union born from the belief that although each individual is the pilot of their own destiny, when we come together, we change the world. We are stronger as a woven rope than as unbound threads.
America has thrived because citizens have been willing to contribute their voices and shed their blood to challenge injustice and protect the nation. It is in keeping with that history of service that, at this moment, I feel the burden to advocate for my values and an enormous urgency to act.
Despite some personal turmoil, I remain hopeful for the future for both my family and for our nation. Impeachment exposed Trump’s corruption, but the confluence of a pandemic, a financial crisis and the stoking of societal divisions has roused the soul of the American people. A groundswell is building that will issue a mandate to reject hate and bigotry and a return to the ideals that set the United States apart from the rest of the world. I look forward to contributing to that effort.
In retirement from the Army, I will continue to defend my nation. I will demand accountability of our leadership and call for leaders of moral courage and public servants of integrity. I will speak about the attacks on our national security. I will advocate for policies and strategies that will keep our nation safe and strong against internal and external threats. I will promote public service and exalt the contribution that service brings to all areas of society.
The 23-year-old me who was commissioned in December 1998 could never have imagined the opportunities and experiences I have had. I joined the military to serve the country that sheltered my family’s escape from authoritarianism, and yet the privilege has been all mine.
When I was asked why I had the confidence to tell my father not to worry about my testimony, my response was, “Congressman, because this is America. This is the country I have served and defended, that all my brothers have served, and here, right matters.”
To this day, despite everything that has happened, I continue to believe in the American Dream. I believe that in America, right matters. I want to help ensure that right matters for all Americans.

👋 Wait! Before you scroll away...🇺🇸
My brother Eugene won one of the closest House races in the country last cycle, and that makes him a big time target for Republicans who want to keep control of the House, and a president who'd love to defeat the second Vindman twin.
Eugene has a big FEC fundraising deadline coming up in a few days. And when it ends, he's got some difficult budget decisions to make about the rest of the campaign and what it takes to win.
He tells me that he's a bit short of where he needs to be right now, so I was hoping people who care about holding the House could help.
**If $15 seems worth it to you to take back the House majority, then I am asking: Please contribute to my brother Eugene Vindman’s campaign today.**

Email is a very important way we communicate with supporters like you. A groundswell is building that will issue a mandate to reject hate and bigotry and a return to the ideals that set the United States apart from the rest of the world. I look forward to contributing to that effort. In retirement from the Army, I will continue to defend my nation. I will demand accountability of our leadership and call for leaders of moral courage and public servants of integrity. I will speak about the attacks on our national security. I will advocate for policies and strategies that will keep our nation safe and strong against internal and external threats. I will promote public service and exalt the contribution that service brings to all areas of society. The 23-year-old me who was commissioned in December 1998 could never have imagined the opportunities and experiences I have had. I joined the military to serve the country that sheltered my family’s escape from authoritarianism, and yet the privilege has been all mine. When I was asked why I had the confidence to tell my father not to worry about my testimony, my response was, “Congressman, because this is America. This is the country I have served and defended, that all my brothers have served, and here, right matters.” To this day, despite everything that has happened, I continue to believe in the American Dream. I believe that in America, right matters. I want to help ensure that right matters for all Americans. 👋 Wait! Before you scroll away...🇺🇸 My brother Eugene won one of the closest House races in the country last cycle, and that makes him a big time target for Republicans who want to keep control of the House, and a president who'd love to defeat the second Vindman twin. Eugene has a big FEC fundraising deadline coming up in a few days. And when it ends, he's got some difficult budget decisions to make about the rest of the campaign and what it takes to win. He tells me that he's a bit short of where he needs to be right now, so I was hoping people who care about holding the House could help. If $15 seems worth it to you to take back the House majority, then I am asking: Please contribute to my brother Eugene Vindman’s campaign today. ** Paid for by the Alex Vindman Victory Fund, a joint fundraising committee authorized by Alex Vindman for Florida, the Democratic Executive Committee of Florida and the DSCC. 4611 S University Drive #194 Davie, FL 33328

Dear Patriot,
**Victorville, California. 4:45 in the morning.** A man walks out of his house in the dark and drives toward a gas station a few minutes down the road. Federal agents are already behind him. **No chase. No standoff. No struggle.** By six o'clock that morning, September 10th, he was in federal custody and it was **OVER.**[](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckb-u3iAMxZ-GbERg8ndgqBRlu107Rv7ASdANEAFJ1bev8lV363Q3-_jnYx3518fyge5wYfuJnrS53ZLyUnb6gylRLmR357HghjkXLAsI6LgYOTQLmuJuWhqsrDa2U1CRlv0ooAU5DtWuWxxfq-oHOUgjrLK2M0b2FteR1h7hVTn92IkRGgmyU22tAI1qBzsMdhWtlKwR12mxUK5NDJnSjc9NF0J8qhhqE3116L2UMzP1g8HMYM5krkQ1BrKxPASDOX4SreTJOtxSvM5H8hvfCS2PKy878Rzwk7h_8TOeyNR8Fb_keCVDTE3_hRl0D_S4Xp6p6b34TzPoT3RbYGr6yvg1iaFQKExN5nYMOvTxereqrZK25293HC53PWvE5tEd74jlm5-5NfwNAAD__7oXodk)
His name is **James Brass.** Down on Skid Row, they called him **"LORD."** And you are the only reason anybody ever went looking for him. [**Help me finish what you started right here.**](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckb-u3iAMxZ-GbERg8ndgqBRlu107Rv7ASdANEAFJ1bev8lV363Q3-_jnYx3518fyge5wYfuJnrS53ZLyUnb6gylRLmR357HghjkXLAsI6LgYOTQLmuJuWhqsrDa2U1CRlv0ooAU5DtWuWxxfq-oHOUgjrLK2M0b2FteR1h7hVTn92IkRGgmyU22tAI1qBzsMdhWtlKwR12mxUK5NDJnSjc9NF0J8qhhqE3116L2UMzP1g8HMYM5krkQ1BrKxPASDOX4SreTJOtxSvM5H8hvfCS2PKy878Rzwk7h_8TOeyNR8Fb_keCVDTE3_hRl0D_S4Xp6p6b34TzPoT3RbYGr6yvg1iaFQKExN5nYMOvTxereqrZK25293HC53PWvE5tEd74jlm5-5NfwNAAD__7oXodk) Let me walk you through exactly how we got from a sidewalk in Los Angeles to a federal courtroom in Riverside, because every single step of it was paid for by ordinary Americans on this list and not by anybody else. **ONE.** We put an undercover camera on Skid Row in Los Angeles and filmed a woman handing two and three dollars to homeless men and women in exchange for their signatures on ballot petitions and their voter registration forms. **TWO.** A federal prosecutor later stated publicly that our video is the reason the FBI opened a criminal investigation, and by May the Justice Department had charged a sixty-four-year-old circulator named Brenda Lee Brown Armstrong with a federal felony. In June, she pleaded guilty to it. **THREE.** Then, on the last day of August, she walked out of that courthouse with eighteen months of probation and no prison whatsoever, and you were furious about it. I know you were furious, because you wrote to me and told me so, and almost every one of you said the same thing. _Get the one above her._ **FOUR.** On September 10th, federal agents arrested the man that prosecutors now say was the one standing above her. [**You paid for the camera that started all of this. Please help me pay for what comes next.**](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckb-u3iAMxZ-GbERg8ndgqBRlu107Rv7ASdANEAFJ1bev8lV363Q3-_jnYx3518fyge5wYfuJnrS53ZLyUnb6gylRLmR357HghjkXLAsI6LgYOTQLmuJuWhqsrDa2U1CRlv0ooAU5DtWuWxxfq-oHOUgjrLK2M0b2FteR1h7hVTn92IkRGgmyU22tAI1qBzsMdhWtlKwR12mxUK5NDJnSjc9NF0J8qhhqE3116L2UMzP1g8HMYM5krkQ1BrKxPASDOX4SreTJOtxSvM5H8hvfCS2PKy878Rzwk7h_8TOeyNR8Fb_keCVDTE3_hRl0D_S4Xp6p6b34TzPoT3RbYGr6yvg1iaFQKExN5nYMOvTxereqrZK25293HC53PWvE5tEd74jlm5-5NfwNAAD__7oXodk) Now let me be careful and precise with you about what this actually is, because you have always gotten the real version from me rather than the convenient fundraising version, and I am not going to break that deal over a single email. **Nobody has been convicted of anything.** James Brass pleaded not guilty. His trial is set for **November 2nd.** Everything I am about to describe is what the Justice Department alleges, and he is entitled to make them prove every word of it in front of a jury. Here is what they allege. They say Brass ran a registered signature-gathering company in California called **Pinnacle Brass.** They say that he and two other defendants reached into a petition company's own internal voter database and pulled out the names of **real, registered California voters** — real names, real home addresses, real people who were going about their lives with no idea any of this was happening. They say they printed those names onto lists. Then they say they carried those printed lists down to Skid Row, handed them to homeless men and women along with two or three dollars in cash, and told them exactly which name and address to copy onto the form. Read that again, because it is not what any of us thought we were filming. **These were not made-up voters. These were your neighbors' REAL NAMES, in a stranger's handwriting, sold for the price of a sandwich.** And then comes the part that stopped me cold when I read it. Prosecutors say that Brass and another defendant then **signed sworn declarations swearing under penalty of perjury that they had personally witnessed every one of those signatures being signed by the actual voter.** For all of that work, prosecutors say, he was paid more than **$41,000.** Two dollars for the man sleeping on the sidewalk. Forty-one thousand dollars for the man they say sent him there. **[>> YES, JAMES — FUND BOTH FRONTS <<](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckb-u3iAMxZ-GbERg8ndgqBRlu107Rv7ASdANEAFJ1bev8lV363Q3-_jnYx3518fyge5wYfuJnrS53ZLyUnb6gylRLmR357HghjkXLAsI6LgYOTQLmuJuWhqsrDa2U1CRlv0ooAU5DtWuWxxfq-oHOUgjrLK2M0b2FteR1h7hVTn92IkRGgmyU22tAI1qBzsMdhWtlKwR12mxUK5NDJnSjc9NF0J8qhhqE3116L2UMzP1g8HMYM5krkQ1BrKxPASDOX4SreTJOtxSvM5H8hvfCS2PKy878Rzwk7h_8TOeyNR8Fb_keCVDTE3_hRl0D_S4Xp6p6b34TzPoT3RbYGr6yvg1iaFQKExN5nYMOvTxereqrZK25293HC53PWvE5tEd74jlm5-5NfwNAAD__7oXodk)** So here is exactly where you and I stand right now, and I am going to give it to you straight, because this investigation has **two fronts open at the same time** and both of them are costing real money this week. **FRONT ONE. THE COURTROOM IN CALIFORNIA.** I sent our reporter out to the federal courthouse in Riverside for his first appearance, and unlike the last time, she was actually inside the room when it happened. She watched him plead not guilty. She watched a federal magistrate set a ten-thousand-dollar appearance bond with his wife signing as the surety, and she watched the court order him to surrender his passport and travel documents, to avoid all contact with every witness and co-defendant in the case, and to submit to mental health treatment. Then she stood outside on the steps and asked his attorney whether he was surprised by the charges. His answer: **"No, it seems like they've been sniffing around."** And you already understand exactly why we have to physically be in that building. At the last sentencing in this same investigation, **the court sealed the transcript, ordered our reporter removed from the room, and then locked the doors behind her.** We ended up learning the sentence out on the sidewalk, the same way that you did. **November 2nd. Riverside, California.** Somebody has to be sitting in that courtroom every day it runs, and there is nobody else coming. [**That somebody is us, and it is paid for by you.**](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckb-u3iAMxZ-GbERg8ndgqBRlu107Rv7ASdANEAFJ1bev8lV363Q3-_jnYx3518fyge5wYfuJnrS53ZLyUnb6gylRLmR357HghjkXLAsI6LgYOTQLmuJuWhqsrDa2U1CRlv0ooAU5DtWuWxxfq-oHOUgjrLK2M0b2FteR1h7hVTn92IkRGgmyU22tAI1qBzsMdhWtlKwR12mxUK5NDJnSjc9NF0J8qhhqE3116L2UMzP1g8HMYM5krkQ1BrKxPASDOX4SreTJOtxSvM5H8hvfCS2PKy878Rzwk7h_8TOeyNR8Fb_keCVDTE3_hRl0D_S4Xp6p6b34TzPoT3RbYGr6yvg1iaFQKExN5nYMOvTxereqrZK25293HC53PWvE5tEd74jlm5-5NfwNAAD__7oXodk) **FRONT TWO. THE TWO TEAMS YOU CANNOT SEE.** While all of that plays out in California, I have **two teams undercover in two different states right now.** I cannot tell you where they are. I cannot tell you what they are working on. If I could, they would not be undercover. What I can tell you is that the airfare, the rental cars, the hotel rooms and the gas do not wait politely for a story to publish. **The bills arrive first.** They arrive whether the story eventually lands or not, and they arrive whether anybody happens to donate that particular week or not. **[>> CHIP IN $35 AND KEEP US ON BOTH FRONTS <<](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckb-u3iAMxZ-GbERg8ndgqBRlu107Rv7ASdANEAFJ1bev8lV363Q3-_jnYx3518fyge5wYfuJnrS53ZLyUnb6gylRLmR357HghjkXLAsI6LgYOTQLmuJuWhqsrDa2U1CRlv0ooAU5DtWuWxxfq-oHOUgjrLK2M0b2FteR1h7hVTn92IkRGgmyU22tAI1qBzsMdhWtlKwR12mxUK5NDJnSjc9NF0J8qhhqE3116L2UMzP1g8HMYM5krkQ1BrKxPASDOX4SreTJOtxSvM5H8hvfCS2PKy878Rzwk7h_8TOeyNR8Fb_keCVDTE3_hRl0D_S4Xp6p6b34TzPoT3RbYGr6yvg1iaFQKExN5nYMOvTxereqrZK25293HC53PWvE5tEd74jlm5-5NfwNAAD__7oXodk)** Now let me tell you why this particular case should matter to you personally, and not simply to me as the person who has been chasing it. Every single name printed on those lists belonged to a real person. Somebody in California who got up that morning, went to work, came home and made dinner, and had no earthly idea that their own name had just been signed onto a political petition they had never read, by a total stranger, for two dollars. **Nobody mails you a letter when that happens to you.** There is no notification, there is no alert, and there is no agency anywhere that picks up the phone and calls your house about it. You simply never find out that it happened at all. The only way anyone ever finds out is if somebody is standing on that sidewalk with a camera. Your name. Your wife's name. Your father's name. **In somebody else's handwriting, on a document you have never seen.** [**That is what this work protects, and that is what I am asking you to fund.**](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckb-u3iAMxZ-GbERg8ndgqBRlu107Rv7ASdANEAFJ1bev8lV363Q3-_jnYx3518fyge5wYfuJnrS53ZLyUnb6gylRLmR357HghjkXLAsI6LgYOTQLmuJuWhqsrDa2U1CRlv0ooAU5DtWuWxxfq-oHOUgjrLK2M0b2FteR1h7hVTn92IkRGgmyU22tAI1qBzsMdhWtlKwR12mxUK5NDJnSjc9NF0J8qhhqE3116L2UMzP1g8HMYM5krkQ1BrKxPASDOX4SreTJOtxSvM5H8hvfCS2PKy878Rzwk7h_8TOeyNR8Fb_keCVDTE3_hRl0D_S4Xp6p6b34TzPoT3RbYGr6yvg1iaFQKExN5nYMOvTxereqrZK25293HC53PWvE5tEd74jlm5-5NfwNAAD__7oXodk) One company. Now think about the other forty-nine states. **America starts voting on September 19th,** which is the day the first federal ballots go out the door. In Truth,James O'KeefeFounder, O'Keefe Media Group

clean_body: Federal agents arrested the man prosecutors say ran it. Our reporter was in the courtroom. Here is what happens next. | Dear Patriot, Victorville, California. 4:45 in the morning. A man walks out of his house in the dark and drives toward a gas station a few minutes down the road. Federal agents are already behind him. No chase. No standoff. No struggle. By six o'clock that morning, September 10th, he was in federal custody and it was OVER. His name is James Brass. Down on Skid Row, they called him "LORD." And you are the only reason anybody ever went looking for him. Let me walk you through exactly how we got from a sidewalk in Los Angeles to a federal courtroom in Riverside, because every single step of it was paid for by ordinary Americans on this list and not by anybody else. ONE. We put an undercover camera on Skid Row in Los Angeles and filmed a woman handing two and three dollars to homeless men and women in exchange for their signatures on ballot petitions and their voter registration forms. TWO. A federal prosecutor later stated publicly that our video is the reason the FBI opened a criminal investigation, and by May the Justice Department had charged a sixty-four-year-old circulator named Brenda Lee Brown Armstrong with a federal felony. In June, she pleaded guilty to it. THREE. Then, on the last day of August, she walked out of that courthouse with eighteen months of probation and no prison whatsoever, and you were furious about it. I know you were furious, because you wrote to me and told me so, and almost every one of you said the same thing. Get the one above her. FOUR. On September 10th, federal agents arrested the man that prosecutors now say was the one standing above her. Now let me be careful and precise with you about what this actually is, because you have always gotten the real version from me rather than the convenient fundraising version, and I am not going to break that deal over a single email. Nobody has been convicted of anything. James Brass pleaded not guilty. His trial is set for November 2nd. Everything I am about to describe is what the Justice Department alleges, and he is entitled to make them prove every word of it in front of a jury. Here is what they allege. They say Brass ran a registered signature-gathering company in California called Pinnacle Brass. They say that he and two other defendants reached into a petition company's own internal voter database and pulled out the names of real, registered California voters — real names, real home addresses, real people who were going about their lives with no idea any of this was happening. They say they printed those names onto lists. Then they say they carried those printed lists down to Skid Row, handed them to homeless men and women along with two or three dollars in cash, and told them exactly which name and address to copy onto the form. Read that again, because it is not what any of us thought we were filming. These were not made-up voters. These were your neighbors' REAL NAMES, in a stranger's handwriting, sold for the price of a sandwich. And then comes the part that stopped me cold when I read it. Prosecutors say that Brass and another defendant then signed sworn declarations swearing under penalty of perjury that they had personally witnessed every one of those signatures being signed by the actual voter. For all of that work, prosecutors say, he was paid more than $41,000. Two dollars for the man sleeping on the sidewalk. Forty-one thousand dollars for the man they say sent him there. So here is exactly where you and I stand right now, and I am going to give it to you straight, because this investigation has two fronts open at the same time and both of them are costing real money this week. FRONT ONE. THE COURTROOM IN CALIFORNIA. I sent our reporter out to the federal courthouse in Riverside for his first appearance, and unlike the last time, she was actually inside the room when it happened. She watched him plead not guilty. She watched a federal magistrate set a ten-thousand-dollar appearance bond with his wife signing as the surety, and she watched the court order him to surrender his passport and travel documents, to avoid all contact with every witness and co-defendant in the case, and to submit to mental health treatment. Then she stood outside on the steps and asked his attorney whether he was surprised by the charges. His answer: "No, it seems like they've been sniffing around." And you already understand exactly why we have to physically be in that building. At the last sentencing in this same investigation, the court sealed the transcript, ordered our reporter removed from the room, and then locked the doors behind her. We ended up learning the sentence out on the sidewalk, the same way that you did. November 2nd. Riverside, California. Somebody has to be sitting in that courtroom every day it runs, and there is nobody else coming. FRONT TWO. THE TWO TEAMS YOU CANNOT SEE. While all of that plays out in California, I have two teams undercover in two different states right now. I cannot tell you where they are. I cannot tell you what they are working on. If I could, they would not be undercover. What I can tell you is that the airfare, the rental cars, the hotel rooms and the gas do not wait politely for a story to publish. The bills arrive first. They arrive whether the story eventually lands or not, and they arrive whether anybody happens to donate that particular week or not. Now let me tell you why this particular case should matter to you personally, and not simply to me as the person who has been chasing it. Every single name printed on those lists belonged to a real person. Somebody in California who got up that morning, went to work, came home and made dinner, and had no earthly idea that their own name had just been signed onto a political petition they had never read, by a total stranger, for two dollars. Nobody mails you a letter when that happens to you. There is no notification, there is no alert, and there is no agency anywhere that picks up the phone and calls your house about it. You simply never find out that it happened at all. The only way anyone ever finds out is if somebody is standing on that sidewalk with a camera. Your name. Your wife's name. Your father's name. In somebody else's handwriting, on a document you have never seen. One company. One sidewalk. One city. And it took an undercover camera and a year and a half of patient work to pull one single thread of it all the way into a federal courtroom. Now think about the other forty-nine states. America starts voting on September 19th, which is the day the first federal ballots go out the door. Whatever is happening on the next sidewalk over is happening right now, today, in the time it takes you to read this email. The only question that has ever mattered is whether anybody is standing there with a camera when it does. There is nobody else writing this check. It has always been you. Thank you for all that you do, and please . . . stay tuned. In Truth,James O'KeefeFounder, O'Keefe Media Group P.S. **On September 10th, federal agents took a man off the street in Victorville at six o'clock in the morning, and prosecutors say he was paid more than forty-one thousand dollars to put your neighbors' names on petitions they never signed.His trial starts November 2nd, and my teams are already working in two other states. ** | Pop Acta Media | Conservative Innovation PO Box 461 Fort Collins, CO 80522 | _

Steny Hoyer served Maryland's 5th for 45 years. He built the military bases that hold up Southern Maryland's economy. Majority leader through the ACA. By any honest measure, one of the most consequential congressmen of the modern era.
Adrian Boafo is 32.
In Part 3 of our conversation last week, we talk about what it means to follow somebody like Steny. Here's what Adrian said that I keep coming back to: the seat doesn't belong to Steny Hoyer. It doesn't belong to him. It doesn't belong to me. It belongs to the people. Your job when you get there is to fight for them. Not to maintain someone else's legacy.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/2449b671-135f-4986-8912-9b8458b94867?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
We get into redistricting, what Question 3 means for Maryland, and why getting Andy Harris out of Congress matters to me personally. Andy Harris bused January 6th rioters to the Capitol. He called for pardons for people who beat police officers. People who beat my brothers and sisters in uniform. That's not ancient history. That's a man who's been in Congress this whole time.
And then I found out Adrian is a DJ.
Not was. Is. He'll say he's retired, then catch himself. DJing saved his life during the pandemic. He was 25, just elected vice mayor of Bowie, trying to keep seniors alive through COVID, and music was the thing that kept him standing. He says a DJ booth is one of the last places in America where Democrats, Republicans, Black, White, it doesn't matter. Everybody's in the same room, happy, together.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..WN2xlmaBVk2YhqTQqgPpEBHfcnDs7vknw2-pAgYMWII?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=217157463)
I worked at the Capitol for 15 years. I always said that building needed elevator music. The vibe in there was wrong from jump. I tell you, if there was music playing in the Capitol, I think it would be a much happier place.
This is the last part of our conversation. Thank you for being here for all three. If you've been reading but haven't subscribed yet, now's the time. This is the work I'm doing and I want you with me for it.
November is six weeks away. Let's go.
-Harry

He built the military bases that hold up Southern Maryland's economy. Majority leader through the ACA. By any honest measure, one of the most consequential congressmen of the modern era. Adrian Boafo is 32. In Part 3 of our conversation last week, we talk about what it means to follow somebody like Steny. Here's what Adrian said that I keep coming back to: the seat doesn't belong to Steny Hoyer. It doesn't belong to him. It doesn't belong to me. It belongs to the people. Your job when you get there is to fight for them. Not to maintain someone else's legacy. We get into redistricting, what Question 3 means for Maryland, and why getting Andy Harris out of Congress matters to me personally. Andy Harris bused January 6th rioters to the Capitol. He called for pardons for people who beat police officers. People who beat my brothers and sisters in uniform. That's not ancient history. That's a man who's been in Congress this whole time. And then I found out Adrian is a DJ. Not was. Is. He'll say he's retired, then catch himself. DJing saved his life during the pandemic. He was 25, just elected vice mayor of Bowie, trying to keep seniors alive through COVID, and music was the thing that kept him standing. He says a DJ booth is one of the last places in America where Democrats, Republicans, Black, White, it doesn't matter. Everybody's in the same room, happy, together. I worked at the Capitol for 15 years. I always said that building needed elevator music. The vibe in there was wrong from jump. I tell you, if there was music playing in the Capitol, I think it would be a much happier place. This is the last part of our conversation. Thank you for being here for all three. Derek, I've met a lot of folks over the last four years, and there's a question I almost always get. Nobody asks me about the polls. No one asks me about the partisan warfare in Washington. What people ask me, over and over, in Erie and Scranton and South Philly, is some version of the same thing: _Is it going to get easier?_ [**I'll tell you exactly how I answer it in a second, but with our End-of-Quarter deadline fast approaching, I have to ask: Will you chip in any amount today to help us build the kind of campaign it’ll take to win Pennsylvania — one voter, one community, and one conversation at a time?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/139835550/648699124/1105271474?refcode=email_092426_question&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MjVhZTJiMC0xN2I4LWYxMTEtYTZhOS0wMDBkM2E1NmQyZjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VBefad1T2XunE5Lcup-g5PtKdhGR7qC0L6VAvBaGhPI=) | | [Chip in →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/139835551/648699125/1105271474?refcode=email_092426_question&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MjVhZTJiMC0xN2I4LWYxMTEtYTZhOS0wMDBkM2E1NmQyZjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VBefad1T2XunE5Lcup-g5PtKdhGR7qC0L6VAvBaGhPI=)

Here's the honest answer, Derek.
Some of it has gotten easier. If you've got a kid in a Pennsylvania public school, breakfast is free now. If you're a senior, your property tax rebate is bigger than it's been in nearly twenty years. If you're a parent paying for childcare, we tripled the credit that helps cover it.
But some of it also hasn't.
Groceries still cost too much. Housing costs too much. A lot of what's driving that comes straight out of the chaos, cruelty, and corruption we’re seeing in Washington DC. But here's what I know after four years of being asked that question: The folks asking it deserve a Governor who will work like hell to answer it. **Not a Governor who's already decided the answer is whatever Donald Trump says it is.**
My far-right opponent said Trump's tariffs were “fantastic.” She called the cuts that raised healthcare premiums for over 400,000 Pennsylvanians "absolutely the right thing to do." And she's never once named an issue where she disagrees with him.
That's not somebody who's going to answer to the good people of Pennsylvania, Derek. That's somebody who's going to take the call from Mar-a-Lago and tell you everything’s perfect.
[**So please, Derek: Chip in $25 or whatever you can before next Wednesday’s big deadline and help us show up for the people asking that question — in every corner of this Commonwealth.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/139835553/648699126/1105271474?refcode=email_092426_question&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MjVhZTJiMC0xN2I4LWYxMTEtYTZhOS0wMDBkM2E1NmQyZjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VBefad1T2XunE5Lcup-g5PtKdhGR7qC0L6VAvBaGhPI=)

This is the moment
Three states are about to decide a lot more than 2026.

| | | |
---
Peter,
---
We've looked at the polling in every swing state and swing race in the country. It's margin of error, either way, almost everywhere.

At this point, it's not about winning anybody over. _It's about who actually shows up._

If conservatives turn out in November, we'll win every critical battleground and lay the groundwork for victory in 2028 and beyond.

That's why Turning Point Action is focusing all our efforts on three key states: Arizona, Nevada, and New Hampshire.

**We call these states the new RED WALL.**

_Let me explain why they matter so much... _

After 2024, Charlie looked at the numbers, looked at the maps, and told our team something simple. If we lock down Arizona, Nevada, and New Hampshire, the Left's entire strategy falls apart. Their map collapses. Their path back to power disappears.

Here's why... Winning the presidency comes down to 270 electoral votes. Lose Arizona and most of the realistic paths to the White House in 2028 are gone. Lose Nevada and New Hampshire and the Left rebuilds the Blue Wall they lost in 2024.

Whoever wins in 2028 controls the 2030 Census. The Census drives redistricting. Redistricting sets the congressional map for the next ten years.

This midterm decides which way that goes.

# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=2507%2E135344%2EdI3PEA)

Quick story -- and then a request for help.
As many of you know, I got recruited to the CIA right out of grad school and was sent on my first of three tours in Iraq. I worked under President Bush and President Obama and was an Acting Assistant Secretary of Defense at the Pentagon when Donald Trump won the first time.
Now here's the part you may not know.
When I was trying to figure out what to do after leaving the Pentagon, I came home to Holly, Michigan and ended up going to my first political meeting.
To find it, I literally Googled "local Democratic Party Holly, Michigan" and there was no such thing. I finally found a group not too far away, and that was my first political event ever.
Several elections later, I am the only Democrat who won a House District that went for Romney in 2012, Trump in 2016 and Trump again in 2020. And I am one of the few U.S. Senators to carry a state won by Donald Trump in 2024.
But what I can tell you is that it is tough campaigning as a Democrat in places like Holly, Michigan. Where I’ve never won my town, precinct, or neighbors (but they’re still the first people I call when my dogs get out).
That is why I am spending a lot of time in the final weeks of this election helping Democrats win in places that have been long counted out -- places where if we can win, we can flip the House and the Senate.
That takes some resources, and there is no single greater source of donations to fund that work than the response from people who care ... people like you.

If [Husted] loses and data centers get the blame, politicians across the country will take notice — and they will not go near the next one.” And since then, GOP megadonors have taken action — they’ve poured millions of dollars into attack ads against Sherrod Brown in a desperate effort to save their pro-data center candidate. Folks,
At the end of this message, I'm going to ask you to chip in $5 to my Senate campaign here in North Carolina. [If you're ready to give now, you can use this link to donate.](https://substack.com/redirect/f247451e-0524-4138-9259-88f257ba150a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/f247451e-0524-4138-9259-88f257ba150a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**Otherwise, please let me explain why your support is so important, and what could happen here in North Carolina without it.**
In 2016, I ran to unseat the incumbent Governor - something no one had done in North Carolina for 150 years - but I knew our team could make history and defeat Pat McCrory. In the lead-up, poll after poll had me with a slight lead, and sometimes, more than that. By all accounts, the momentum was on our side.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4eeca410-5d12-41da-9c6e-32eb7773def5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**However, it was too close to call on election night.** I went to bed leading by fewer than 5,000 votes ... out of 4.6 million. Instead of conceding, the incumbent Governor called for a recount, and he spent the next month claiming voter fraud and undermining faith in the democratic process.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f5f9b566-8137-4d33-a7f1-330d901d77ec?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Still, democracy won out on Dec. 5, 2016 - and so did we, by 10,277 votes.**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f50a4dc3-f440-4829-8308-429df542b5ff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Fast-forward 10 years, and this current Senate race is starting to remind me a lot of 2016. Just like back then, the momentum appears to be on our side. According to The New York Times, this is the best chance in the entire country for Democrats to flip a Republican-held seat.
**We could 've just as easily lost in 2016 though. The margin of victory was only 0.22%.**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/28b3aa37-8243-4828-ad07-3647cd0aa100?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
RealClearPolitics, 2016 North Carolina Governor - McCrory vs. Cooper
That's why we simply cannot take our foot off the gas this time around. We cannot look at the polls and the predictions and think for a second that we have this in the bag. We cannot give our Republican opponent or the right-wing super PACs supporting him an inch.
**I won in 2016 - in the same election that President Trump first won the presidency in North Carolina - only because of grassroots support from people like you. That's how I plan to win this time, but I need you with me once again.**
[Please, will you chip in $5, or whatever you can, today to help us flip North Carolina blue and take back the Senate for Democrats?](https://substack.com/redirect/f247451e-0524-4138-9259-88f257ba150a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/f247451e-0524-4138-9259-88f257ba150a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Thank you for reading. I really appreciate it.
Roy Cooper

My grandmother says, _Dame las flores en vida y no en muerte._ As I grew into adulthood, I began to buy her the flowers for which she pleaded. Yet I never quite saw the bloom I expected in her eyes.
When a seed is planted, we expect the bloom. I give her the strength of stones now, and by the flicker of light I know she still expects the flowers of self-government: the bristled and the silken, the vibrant and the muted, the composed and the unfolding, the fragrant and the subtle.
**Pause.
Breathe.
Look Deeper.**
**Refuel.**
**Welcome to Sweet Ground.**

As I grew into adulthood, I began to buy her the flowers for which she pleaded. Yet I never quite saw the bloom I expected in her eyes. When a seed is planted, we expect the bloom. I give her the strength of stones now, and by the flicker of light I know she still expects the flowers of self-government: the bristled and the silken, the vibrant and the muted, the composed and the unfolding, the fragrant and the subtle. body:
